title: Drumstick: modeled ₹2,530/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Kanjirappally
summary: February 2022: reported drumstick prices at Perumbavoor and Kanjirappally imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 75% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹2,530 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 228 same-variety market pairs screened for drumstick in February 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kanjirappally report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2022
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Kanjirappally (Kerala) both reported drumstick prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹19,000 per quintal. Kanjirappally reported a median ₹24,300 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹3,800/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹3,800 per quintal, and Kanjirappally was dearer on 79% of days.

scenes.headline: 82 km by road
scenes.caption: 82 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹18/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,618 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹717 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kanjirappally report, the rule selects 21 of 24 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹2,530 per quintal (₹1,339 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Drumstick route from Perumbavoor to Kanjirappally was positive on 75% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹253,000, or ₹133,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to drumstick
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹18/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Drumstick route from Perumbavoor to Kanjirappally was positive on 75% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹253,000, or ₹133,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
